boundary: Owner: marine permit and discharge permit (EIA conditions). Contractor: outfall pipeline and diffuser; treated effluents (SC-020, SC-057) join the outfall upstream of the discharge monitoring.
connection: Outfall diffuser about 350 m offshore at -8 m
location_text: About 350 m offshore, at least 250 m from the intake
remarks: Discharge limits: <= 3 K excess at the edge of the 100 m mixing zone, residual chlorine <= 0.1 mg/l; pressure at the diffuser is hydrostatic (HMB pressure check not applicable).
